---
name: feedback-name-the-side
description: Name the organisation, not only the person
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Notes recorded who said something but not which side they were on, and a month later the note could not be used.

**Why:** the position matters more than the name once the conversation is cold.

**How to apply:** every recorded position carries its organisation, and where two parties disagree, both sides are named.
